jobPostingInfo.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data & Streaming Platform (Hybrid)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
This is a hybrid role. The team is in Fabrikam's Springfield office three days a week.

The Work

As a Principal Software Engineer on this team you set the technical direction of the streaming tier.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of software engineering experience.

Where the role requires a move we pay a relocation allowance of $10,000.00 - $15,000.00.

The salary range posted for this role is $310,000.00 to $402,000.00, excluding incentive pay, equity and benefits.

A higher range applies in some locations:

$326,000.00 – $471,500.00

An annual bonus is offered under the terms of the company plan.
